messages:
Ava: Quick experiment — I'm making an "espresso passport" for mugs: small sticker for each drink/style. Leave the sticker on your mug in the kitchen when you make/bring something. First sticker = brag rights. Thoughts? :coffee:

Matt: Love it. Can we have emoji categories? ☕ espresso, 🥯 latte, 🧊 cold brew

Lina: Also can we add a "do not microwave" tiny sticker? :eyes:

Ava: Ha yes. Thinking a tiny legend on the fridge. Proposal: ☕ = brewed, 🍩 = shared snack, 🧊 = cold, 🚫 = do-not-mw

inventory-bot: Created label set `espresso-passport-v1`. QR sheet uploaded: https://tiny.redwood/esp-pass (automated)

Chloe: Found two mystery mugs with stickers: "☕ AVA" and "🍪 UNKNOWN" — who is 🍪? :detective:

Matt: guilty — left the cookie-challenge mug in the meeting room. i'll claim 🍪. sorry about that :sweat_smile:

Lina: Cute. Can someone design 8x8 sticker art? I can try a rough pass but not a pro.

Ava: Yes please! Bonus if they match the office color palette. I'll make a Google Slides and drop the template.

Matt: Suggest rule: stickers transfer with the mug if you lend it. Also maybe numbered sequence for repeats (collect 'em all). :sticker:

Chloe: Suggest adding a tiny "last washed" marker — like `1d`/`3d` for cleanliness. Low effort hygiene win.

cleaning-bot: Reminder — dishwasher run at 17:00 daily. Please stack mugs handle-side-in. :broom:

Ava: Example sticker filename idea (for print):
```
sticker-format:
<emoji>-<owner-initials>-<seq>
example: ☕-AV-01
```

Lina: That format is great and machine-readable if we track it later. :nerd_face:

Chloe: I'll take care of mockups tonight. Anyone want to add a silly category? I'm adding "🐉 = dragon energy" for chaotic coffee.

Matt: I'll print a sheet tomorrow at 9am. Who wants one sticker pack? react with :hand:

Ava: :hand: Thanks y'all — fridge legend up in 10. Meeting room cookie mug reclaimed. :sparkles:

Matt: Printing and laminating stickers at 9:15. Whoever wants a laminated 1-off come find me.

Lina: micro-commit — naming the initiative: "Espresso Passport Program (EPP)" :tada:

Chloe: EPP is adorable. Long live sticker diplomacy. :crown:
